name: wx-vsce-ron-ultra
description: RON (Rusty Object Notation) language server — syntax highlighting, diagnostics, validation and completion against the Rust struct a file deserializes into (/* @[crate::config::GameConfig] */), go to definition, comment-preserving formatting, outline, hovers and smart select, powered by WebAssembly.

ronUltra.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report syntax errors, invalid literals, mixed named and positional fields, duplicate fields and keys, unknown extensions, and mismatches with the annotated Rust type.

ronUltra.schema.enabled.markdownDescription: Check files that name their Rust type in a comment, such as `/* @[crate::config::GameConfig] */`, against that type — and offer its fields and variants as completions. The path resolves in the crate whose `Cargo.toml` is nearest above the file.

ronUltra.format.enabled.description: Format RON files with the built-in, comment-preserving formatter.

ronUltra.format.printWidth.markdownDescription: Widest line a container may be collapsed onto, as in `(x: 1, y: 2)`. Containers that do not fit are written one entry per line. `0` expands every non-empty container.

scripts.package: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
